evidence.title: Teraco announces CT1 data centre expansion in Rondebosch, Cape Town
evidence.excerpt: Teraco's official CT1 expansion page, visibly updated on July 17, 2026, says the Rondebosch expansion is currently underway and will add 2 MW of critical IT load.
